notes.title: BETA Testing Coming Late January / Early February
notes.notes:
We will be taking emails for our closed BETA testing (beginning some time late January or early February) via our Discord AMA.

If you attend the AMA there is a very good chance you will be able to test during closed BETA as well as be rewarded with a free game key once Lock Her Up is released.

January 7th @ 1pm Central Time at Three Guys Discord:

https://discord.gg/hbPRxv
